window: RECENT design window 2026-06-21 .. 2026-11-01 (SEEN: looked at here, nothing here is evidence; DEV scores come from phase3_dev.py, card c26-h1-structural-lower-high)

verdict.label: Design look on SEEN, n=30: buyers won the top quarter in 29 of 30 (taker delta positive); 0 take-outs had a sell-imbalance row at the top

why: The high of a take-out is made by buyers lifting offers, so a positive top-quarter delta is the normal case, not a tell.
A footprint 'absorption' read needs sellers winning the top rows; it almost never shows here, so it is no Phase 3 filter.
The CoinGlass page's 'Absorption bullish' label is its bottom signal and was stale (fired before the 82k top), not a top signal.
